maintainability: Ease of understanding, changing and testing capabilities without ripple effects.
extensibility: Ability to add capabilities/providers/platforms without destabilizing core behavior.
testability: Ability to verify business rules, contracts and adapters deterministically.
operability: Ease of deployment, monitoring, debugging, rollback and support.
performance: Latency, throughput and resource efficiency under expected workloads.
availability: Ability to remain useful during component or dependency failures.
security: Confidentiality, integrity, least privilege, isolation and auditability.
portability: Ability to support required platforms without forced lowest-common-denominator design.
reversibility: Cost of changing a decision later.
